ModMetaData.name: Over Haulers
ModMetaData.author: Jay "iClustaFlux" Rogers
ModMetaData.description:
Dynamically overhauls Caravan Mass Capacity based on authentic pawn anatomy, bionic upgrades, physical injuries, and systemic physical stamina.
Ever wonder why an Archotech-augmented supersoldier carries the exact same 35kg caravan weight as a 90-year-old pawn with asthma and peg legs?
KEY FEATURES: - Bionics & Prosthetics: High-tier artificial limbs boost carrying potential, while crude prosthetics or lost limbs penalize it. - Bilateral Symmetry & Axial Spine Loading: Spinal columns bear structural compression; losing an arm reduces the lifting power of the remaining arm. - Systemic Health: Breathing, blood pumping, movement, and consciousness dynamically scale caravan capacity. - Interactive Test Bench: Simulate surgeries, injuries, and drug regimens on any species in Mod Settings. - Performance Engineered: Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) solver with zero garbage collection allocations on tick hot paths. - Universal Compatibility: Dynamically adapts to modded races, bionics mods (EPOE/RBSE), and Vanilla Expanded without hardcoded patches.
Safe to add or remove mid-save.
